### ✨ Where Winds Meet Mod Menu (v1.0.28)
Pro Glass UI Mod Menu for **Where Winds Meet** by **m0hammed** (`@m0hmm3d`) — supports both **Rootless (`arm64`)** and **RootHide (`arm64e`)**.

### 🔥 Mod Features
- **God Mode (Invincible)** — Prevents player HP loss and sets incoming enemy damage to 0
- **Damage Multiplier (1x - 50x)** — Multiplies outgoing player attack damage (Single mode)
- **Auto Heal** — Automatically restores player HP to maximum during combat
- **Invisible (Stealth Mode)** — Enemies cannot detect or spot your character
- **Untargetable (No Aggro)** — Skips NPC aggro table so enemies ignore you
- **No Fall Damage** — Complete immunity to fall damage from any height
- **Move Speed Multiplier (1x - 5x)** — Scales player action and movement speed (Single mode)

### 🔒 License & Activation
- **1-User Device Lock**: Each token locks automatically to the first device that activates it.
- **Trial & Full Keys**: Supports `2h` trial keys, `30d` plans, and Lifetime keys.
- **Telegram Support & Keys**: Contact **@m0hmm3d** on Telegram.
